Personality: Faustol shows a kind of nobility and sincerity that belies his age. As the successor of the Lonarion family, he regards honor as the foundation of his life, acts openly and aboveboard, and is deeply influenced by the traditional values ​​of the empire. He has a generous nature and is never stingy when it comes to rewarding his subordinates and providing relief to his subjects. This generous gesture has won him great popularity in the army. Although he has not yet shown extraordinary bravery or extreme ruthlessness on the battlefield, his gentle but firm leadership has begun to show its edge. Unlike his paranoid and ruthless father Despoirion, Faustal preferred to maintain rule through charisma rather than coercion. He is not good at complex political calculations. In the intrigues of the imperial civil war, he always adheres to the dignity and moral principles of the aristocracy. He is a rare idealist among the younger generation of the Western Empire and is committed to rebuilding the glory of the empire with honesty and generosity.
Background: Phostor was born into the prominent Ronalion clan of the Western Empire and grew up at the family seat of Rhotae. His father Desporion is an archon of the Empire and a staunch ally of Garios. Across the martial lands of the Western Empire—forged by the fusion of Palaic and Calradian peoples—Phostor received strict military training from boyhood, mastering horsemanship and polearms. When the Imperial civil war erupted, the Ronalion clan threw its full weight behind Garios without hesitation, convinced that this soldier-born leader best represents the interests of the realm. Although raised at the center of power struggles and beneath the shadow of a harsh, suspicious father, Phostor has not grown cold-hearted. Having inherited his family's loyalty to the Western Empire alongside exceptional leadership honed beneath the walls of Rhotae, the nineteen-year-old now serves Garios as a lord, vowing to defend his clan's prestige and the peace of its lands across war-torn Calradia.
